policy: Differentiate public game variants from internal/source-local state labels. Color or scene selectors can narrow a family without proving a physical release; physical equivalence is never inferred solely because a candidate shares the character name.

supported_physical_family.name: RA-7 Protocol Droid, Pearl Dark Gray
RA-7 Protocol Droid, Dark Bluish Gray

records.reason: The physical catalog supports gray RA-7 variants, not a green RA-7. Treat Green as a digital/source-local color state and do not map it to the nearest gray physical droid.

The game explicitly exposes a Starkiller Base Rey variant. The leading physical family is the 2015 Episode VII dark-tan-robed Rey used across several Force Awakens sets, but the catalog name does not encode the Starkiller scene; retain scene-state verification separately from exact physical equivalence.

Episode V is meaningful timeline evidence, but 'White' is not a public-facing Skywalker Saga Luke variant label and does not uniquely correspond to one physical catalog release. Hoth, Dagobah/training, and Bespin/Jedi appearances all require different context; preserve the color selector without forcing a physical candidate.

physical_candidates.name: Luke Skywalker, Black Robes, Yellow Skin, Black Cape and Hood
Luke Skywalker, Black Robes, Black Hood and Cape

records.reason: HoodedCape is meaningful appearance evidence and selects black-robed hood/cape Luke families, but it lacks episode/story timing. Multiple physical implementations exist, so exact release and source-equivalence remain unresolved.

physical_candidates.name: Luke Skywalker, White Robe, Yellow Skin
Luke Skywalker, White Robe, White Legs, Cheek Lines
Luke Skywalker, White Robe, White Legs, No Cheek Lines

records.reason: Tatooine is valid scene/era evidence and narrows Luke to his Episode IV white-robed family, but several physical versions span different years and face-print details. Exact release requires visual/component comparison.
